component.name: Sound Blaster X4
component.summary: Equalizer, effects and subwoofer control for the Creative Sound Blaster X4

description.p: A control panel for the Creative Sound Blaster X4 USB sound card on Linux. It talks to the X4 directly, so its hardware equalizer and output switching work just as they do with Creative's Windows software.

ul.li: The X4's 10-band hardware equalizer and pre-amp, with presets and a live EQ curve
A spectrum analyzer that listens through the X4's own loopback
SBX-style effects: Surround, Dialog+, Bass, Crystalizer and Smart Volume
Subwoofer support with an adjustable crossover, level and polarity
Room EQ that tames booming bass notes, predicted from your room's size and tuned by ear, with no microphone needed
Mixer controls for outputs, monitoring and recording
A tray icon, light and dark themes

description.p: The effects, subwoofer and room EQ run on PipeWire. This is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Creative Technology Ltd.

screenshot.caption: Equalizer, EQ curve and spectrum analyzer
Room EQ with predicted resonances and test tones

description.p: Two new spectrum analyzer styles: a scrolling spectrogram and a stereo ring that pulses with the bass.
Subwoofer and effect controls now apply while audio plays. Effects keep working when PipeWire can't load LV2 plugins, and 2.1 setup for WirePlumber 0.4.
App store details: description, screenshots and links.
Security hardening from a review; no visible changes.
Room EQ: tame your room's bass by ear, no microphone needed. The mouse wheel no longer changes sliders while scrolling.
Subwoofer crossover, crossover graph, EQ curve, analyzer upgrades and a dark theme.
